fields.label: Main Objectives
fields.value: 1. To carry on business of build, sell, construct, develop, administer, manage, maintain all kinds of buildings either singly or jointly. 2. To carry on business of purchase of any land, plot(s) of land or immovable property either singly or jointly or in Partnership with any person(s) or Body corporate or partnership Firm to develop and construct all kinds of buildings. 3. To undertake such other businesses and business activities which are related to the main activities/business of the LLP or in furtherance and as may be mutually agreed to between the Designated Partners of the LLP. 4. To deal with all kinds of Immovable properties free hold or lease hold or having any other rights interest or share attached to them whether belonging to the firm or not. 5.To act as agent for sellers and buyers of lands, buildings, flats both commercial and residential, agricultural farms and other Immovable properties and collect commission, rent or income thereof.
